PORT.description: Port Open WebUI listens on - leave as is

WEBUI_URL.description: Public URL of Open WebUI (links, OAuth callbacks) - set it to your custom domain after adding one

WEBUI_SECRET_KEY.description: Signs login sessions and encrypts stored OAuth tokens - changing it logs everyone out

DATABASE_URL.description: Users, chats and settings live in Postgres on the private network

OPENAI_API_BASE_URL.description: LiteLLM on the private network - every model you add in LiteLLM shows up here (only read on first boot, later edit it in Admin Settings > Connections)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Key Open WebUI uses to call LiteLLM (its master key)

ENABLE_OLLAMA_API.description: No bundled Ollama - models come through LiteLLM

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: First boot runs the database migrations and downloads the small local embedding model for document search

PORT.description: Port LiteLLM listens on - leave as is

LITELLM_MASTER_KEY.description: Admin API key, and the password for the LiteLLM admin UI at /ui (username admin)

LITELLM_SALT_KEY.description: Encrypts provider API keys stored in the database. BACK IT UP and never change it, or stored keys become unreadable

DATABASE_URL.description: LiteLLM's own database (models, virtual keys, spend) in the shared Postgres

STORE_MODEL_IN_DB.description: Add and edit models in the LiteLLM admin UI instead of a config file

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: First boot applies a few hundred database migrations before the health check can pass

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenAI key, used by models you add in LiteLLM without their own key

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional Anthropic key, used by models you add in LiteLLM without their own key

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenRouter key, used by models you add in LiteLLM without their own key

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional Google AI Studio key, used by models you add in LiteLLM without their own key

POSTGRES_DB.description: Open WebUI's database (LiteLLM gets a second database, litellm, on first boot)

PGDATA.description: Data subdirectory - keeps Postgres happy on Railway volumes

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for Postgres to shut down cleanly on redeploy
